importDir.description: Folder scanned recursively for .eml and .mbox files. Relative paths resolve from the Shale project root; ~/ is supported. This import mode does not require an account.

syncEnabled.description: Run read-only IMAP sync on the email-sync cron, using the account connected on the Accounts page or configured environment fallback.

host.description: IMAP server hostname. Configure this and username for headless sync; an account connected on the Accounts page can supply them instead.

port.description: IMAP implicit-TLS port. The connector uses TLS from connection start; STARTTLS is not used.

username.description: IMAP account username. Credentials connected on the Accounts page take precedence over this value.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable used for a headless IMAP password or app password when no account is connected on the Accounts page.

mailboxes.description: Mailboxes to examine and sync. Mail is accessed read-only; messages are not marked read or moved.

initialSyncDays.description: How far back the first IMAP sync reaches. 0 fetches the full mailbox history.

maxMessagesPerMailbox.description: Maximum messages fetched per mailbox in one run. The UID cursor resumes on the next run.

pythonBin.description: Python 3.10+ interpreter used for the standard-library IMAP worker. No pip packages are required.

syncTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum duration of one IMAP worker invocation.

namespace.description: Namespace for email sources and graph entities.

gapMinutes.description: A silence longer than this starts a new email conversation window.

maxWindowChars.description: Maximum transcript characters per window; keep at or below 12000 so whole windows stay searchable.

idleMinutes.description: The newest conversation window is indexed only after this much silence.

maxWindowsPerRun.description: Windows indexed per summary batch. Long runs process multiple batches.

summarize.description: Summarise each email window with the chat LLM; otherwise a heuristic summary is used.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for conversation summaries. Empty uses the default.

excludeBots.description: Leave bot messages out of transcripts. Email defaults to including them.
